gate_1_complete_shared_language.notes: Full typed language support: Boolean, checked signed integers, arbitrary naturals, UTF-8 text, dynamic collections, safe options, functions, composition, modules, file effects across both Rust and Goose runtimes.

gate_2_exact_finite_semantics_repair.notes: Acyclic state model, atomic batch admission, sound cutoff, minimal ready subset independence, no partial publication on failure.

gate_3_demand_recurrence_halting.notes: Ancestor-closed demand isolates unreachable nodes; deterministic 2-counter-machine simulation halts/executes finite prefixes; explicit halting bounds.

gate_4_immutable_graph_replacement_memor.notes: Atomic generation switches, pinned readers survive eviction, memory churn / soak tested without dangling pointers or torn reads.

gate_5_effects_concurrency_recovery.notes: Explicit sampled output effects (--emit), lexical path restriction, multi-worker parallel scheduling (1, 2, 4 workers) with no data races.

gate_6_native_gpu_physical_hardware.summary: Forced single physical adapter verified via Mesa device select. 42 observed GPU episodes match identically between Rust wgpu and Goose SDL3 across eq/lt/le and 7 lane widths. 77 Goose SDL3 checks passed. Single device verified via DOC_PHYSICAL_VULKAN_SINGLE_DEVICE_PASS.

gate_8_proof_trace_and_signoff.notes: Model trace audited, claim map updated with current dual-runtime evidence, reproducible local test runner committed (ci/run-all-local.sh).
